name: Is a small amount of water meter movement normal?

mainEntity.name: Is a small amount of water meter movement normal?

acceptedAnswer.text: A small amount of water meter movement is not typically normal if all water-using fixtures and appliances are definitely off. While some meters might have a tiny bit of residual 'play' or fluctuation, continuous or consistent movement, even if slow, is a strong indicator of a leak. It's always best to treat any observed movement as a potential leak and investigate it. Even a slow leak can waste thousands of gallons of water annually and lead to increased utility costs.
acceptedAnswer.description: No, consistent water meter movement is not normal when all water is off, even if it's slow. It usually indicates a leak.
